uncertainty_source: Different metrics and human-reference protocols (Pearson r, PRAUC, weighted-F1, kappa, raw agreement, adjudication).
safe_interpretation: Do not rank evaluators across studies or pool scores.
evidence_needed_to_reduce_uncertainty: Run a shared benchmark with identical outputs, raters, annotation instructions, and evaluator metrics.

uncertainty_source: ARES uses PPI-based system-ranking correlations; Ragas reports pairwise preference agreement on WikiEval.
safe_interpretation: No framework winner can be inferred.
evidence_needed_to_reduce_uncertainty: Evaluate both frameworks on the same RAG outputs and same human labels.

uncertainty_source: FACTBENCH compares Llama 3.1 70B/405B; LongFact studies 13 models across four families.
safe_interpretation: Treat scaling effect as benchmark/model dependent; no universal law.
evidence_needed_to_reduce_uncertainty: Matched model families/sizes evaluated on both benchmarks under same generation settings.

uncertainty_source: Entity-frequency groups and benchmark difficulty tiers are not equivalent operationalizations.
safe_interpretation: Convergent direction only; no pooled effect or causal interpretation.
evidence_needed_to_reduce_uncertainty: Measure entity frequency and prompt difficulty jointly on the same examples/models.

uncertainty_source: Claim/evidence extraction, multi-paper traceability, and full-paper QA use different units and metrics.
safe_interpretation: Do not compare their headline scores as a leaderboard.
evidence_needed_to_reduce_uncertainty: Create a shared task taxonomy and common evaluation subset.

uncertainty_source: Scholar-CS rubric accuracy differs from QASPER answer/evidence F1; datasets and tasks differ.
safe_interpretation: OpenScholar result does not establish QASPER is solved or contradicted.
evidence_needed_to_reduce_uncertainty: Run same model/system on both datasets with harmonized answer and evidence metrics.

uncertainty_source: T2-RAGBench uses financial retrieval metrics; CRAG uses end-to-end accuracy and varying corpus construction.
safe_interpretation: No stable task-independent retrieval ranking established.
evidence_needed_to_reduce_uncertainty: Benchmark same retrievers and corpus configurations on shared queries; report retrieval and answer metrics.

uncertainty_source: RGB tests supplied noisy/counterfactual passages; T2-RAGBench measures ranking quality and corpus-scale effects.
safe_interpretation: Evidence quality is a likely bottleneck, but effects are not numerically comparable.
evidence_needed_to_reduce_uncertainty: Factorial test varying retrieval quality/noise and retrieval strategy on same QA task.

uncertainty_source: CLAIM-BENCH is AI-paper extraction; CliVER is clinical claim verification and transfer-only.
safe_interpretation: Do not generalize clinical performance to general AI scientific claims.
evidence_needed_to_reduce_uncertainty: Adapt shared claim/evidence labels and evaluate both domains separately with domain experts.

uncertainty_source: κ values are similar but annotation units, labels, domains, and instructions differ.
safe_interpretation: Similar kappa values are not replication or proof of common difficulty.
evidence_needed_to_reduce_uncertainty: Use common annotation protocol, shared calibration, and report per-label agreement.

uncertainty_source: Benefits on some QA tasks coexist with degradation under counterfactual context; tasks and systems differ.
safe_interpretation: Retrieval is conditional on relevance, evidence quality, and model rejection ability.
evidence_needed_to_reduce_uncertainty: Controlled experiment varying evidence relevance while holding model, task, and prompt fixed.

uncertainty_source: Only one directly relevant controlled study in this corpus; no matched independent replication.
uncertainty_level: High for corpus gap; low for generalization
safe_interpretation: Report as single-study evidence, not cross-paper consensus.
evidence_needed_to_reduce_uncertainty: Independent replication across model families/domains with matched controls.

uncertainty_source: Human agreement and adjudicated disagreement wins use distinct evaluation subsets and protocols.
safe_interpretation: Do not conflate 72% agreement with 76% adjudicated wins as one metric.
evidence_needed_to_reduce_uncertainty: Report both metrics separately and reproduce with independent blinded raters.
